verdict.rationale: Unstructured lets you define source-to-destination workflows through a no-code designer, SDK, or REST API, and run them as processing jobs. You can trigger runs, monitor status, and inspect failed files, and source connectors such as Azure Blob, Box, and Confluence ingest data into these pipelines. That amounts to background pipeline execution, but the evidence only shows runs being triggered manually or by API call. Nothing shows them firing on their own. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or cron-style recurring runs, event-driven triggers on new source data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.
